# Convertible core: the single C++ engine shared by every app.
#
# Targets
#   convertible_core / convertible::core   static library, public API = include/convertible/*.h(pp)
#   convertible_core_internal              INTERFACE target exposing the src/ headers
#                                          (tests and in-tree tools only; apps must not use it)
#   convertible (CLI)                      when CVT_BUILD_CLI
#   convertible_tests                      when CVT_BUILD_TESTS
#
# Family engineers: do not edit this file. Sources under src/families/<family>/
# and tests under tests/families/<family>/ are picked up by glob, and
# src/families/<family>/family.cmake (optional) is included automatically.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

if(NOT DEFINED PROJECT_NAME)
  # Allow `add_subdirectory(core)` from an app build (Android/NDK, Emscripten,
  # iOS) as well as configuring core/ on its own.
  project(ConvertibleCore VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
  include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/CvtCxxStandard.cmake")
  set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED OFF)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
  set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
  if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    include(CTest)
  endif()
endif()

set(CVT_CORE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
set(CVT_CORE_VERSION "0.1.0")
include("${CVT_CORE_DIR}/cmake/CvtHelpers.cmake")
# No-op when the including project already chose a standard.
include("${CVT_CORE_DIR}/cmake/CvtCxxStandard.cmake")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Options
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR OR CVT_IS_TOP_LEVEL)
  set(_cvt_standalone ON)
else()
  set(_cvt_standalone OFF)
endif()

set(_cvt_mobile_or_web OFF)
if(EMSCRIPTEN OR ANDROID OR IOS OR CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "^(iOS|tvOS|watchOS|visionOS)$")
  set(_cvt_mobile_or_web ON)
endif()

set(_cvt_tools_default ${_cvt_standalone})
if(_cvt_mobile_or_web)
  set(_cvt_tools_default OFF)
endif()

option(CVT_BUILD_TESTS "Build the convertible_tests executable" ${_cvt_tools_default})
option(CVT_BUILD_CLI "Build the convertible command-line tool" ${_cvt_tools_default})
option(CVT_WASM_EXCEPTIONS "Emscripten: build with native WebAssembly exception handling" ON)
set(CVT_SANITIZE "" CACHE STRING "Sanitizers for the core, tests and any imported code, e.g. \"address;undefined\" (ON = both)")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core library
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
file(GLOB_RECURSE CVT_CORE_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
  "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src/engine/*.cpp"
  "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src/engine/*.hpp"
  "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src/codec/*.cpp"
  "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src/codec/*.hpp"
  "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src/ir/*.hpp"
  "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src/util/*.cpp"
  "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src/util/*.hpp"
  "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src/families/*.cpp"
  "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src/families/*.hpp"
  "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src/families/*.c"
  "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src/families/*.h")

add_library(convertible_core STATIC
  ${CVT_CORE_SOURCES}
  "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/include/convertible/convertible.h"
  "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/include/convertible/convertible.hpp")
add_library(convertible::core ALIAS convertible_core)

target_include_directories(convertible_core
  PUBLIC "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CVT_CORE_DIR}/include>"
  PRIVATE "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src")
target_compile_definitions(convertible_core
  PRIVATE CVT_BUILDING_CORE CVT_VERSION_STRING="${CVT_CORE_VERSION}"
  PUBLIC CVT_STATIC)
set_target_properties(convertible_core PROPERTIES
  OUTPUT_NAME convertible_core
  POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
  C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
  CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
  VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON)
cvt_set_warnings(convertible_core)
cvt_apply_sanitizers(convertible_core)

if(EMSCRIPTEN AND CVT_WASM_EXCEPTIONS)
  # The engine reports failures through return values, but the standard
  # library can still throw (std::bad_alloc); the C boundary catches
  # everything, which needs exception handling enabled.
  target_compile_options(convertible_core PUBLIC -fwasm-exceptions)
  target_link_options(convertible_core PUBLIC -fwasm-exceptions)
endif()

# The core needs nothing but a C++ compiler and its standard library: no
# find_package, no system libraries, no downloads. Thread support on
# Linux-like systems is a compiler flag, not a dependency.
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" AND NOT ANDROID)
  target_compile_options(convertible_core PUBLIC -pthread)
  target_link_options(convertible_core PUBLIC -pthread)
endif()

# Internal headers for tests and in-tree tools.
add_library(convertible_core_internal INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(convertible_core_internal INTERFACE "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src")
target_link_libraries(convertible_core_internal INTERFACE convertible_core)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-family build fragments
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A family may ship src/families/<family>/family.cmake to add compile
# definitions to `convertible_core` or, where project policy allows it, to
# compile imported code from src/imported/<name>/ with cvt_add_imported().
# Inside the fragment, CVT_FAMILY_DIR is the family's source directory.
# Fragments must not download, look up or build anything outside the tree.
file(GLOB CVT_FAMILY_FRAGMENTS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/src/families/*/family.cmake")
list(SORT CVT_FAMILY_FRAGMENTS)
foreach(fragment IN LISTS CVT_FAMILY_FRAGMENTS)
  get_filename_component(CVT_FAMILY_DIR "${fragment}" DIRECTORY)
  get_filename_component(CVT_FAMILY_NAME "${CVT_FAMILY_DIR}" NAME)
  include("${fragment}")
endforeach()
unset(CVT_FAMILY_DIR)
unset(CVT_FAMILY_NAME)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(CVT_BUILD_CLI)
  add_executable(convertible_cli "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/cli/main.cpp")
  set_target_properties(convertible_cli PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME convertible)
  target_link_libraries(convertible_cli PRIVATE convertible_core_internal)  # internal only for util/json.hpp
  if(MINGW)
    target_link_options(convertible_cli PRIVATE -municode)  # entry point is wmain
  endif()
  cvt_set_warnings(convertible_cli)
  cvt_apply_sanitizers(convertible_cli)
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(CVT_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  file(GLOB_RECURSE CVT_TEST_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/tests/*.cpp"
    "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/tests/*.hpp")
  add_executable(convertible_tests ${CVT_TEST_SOURCES})
  target_link_libraries(convertible_tests PRIVATE convertible_core_internal)
  target_include_directories(convertible_tests PRIVATE "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/tests")
  # Test fixtures live in tests/data/<family>/; the absolute location is
  # injected here at build time and never appears in a source file.
  target_compile_definitions(convertible_tests PRIVATE CVT_TEST_DATA_DIR="${CVT_CORE_DIR}/tests/data")
  cvt_set_warnings(convertible_tests)
  cvt_apply_sanitizers(convertible_tests)
  add_test(NAME convertible_tests COMMAND convertible_tests)
  if(CVT_BUILD_CLI)
    add_test(NAME convertible_cli_smoke
      COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
        -DCLI=$<TARGET_FILE:convertible_cli>
        -DWORK_DIR=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cli_smoke
        -P "${CVT_CORE_DIR}/tests/cli_smoke.cmake")
  endif()
endif()
